notes: Sample: seeded (numpy default_rng(20261102)) 100 condition strings used by industry trials, drawn by python -m scripts.audit_samples. Labels are very clean. Qualifiers (childhood/adolescent, moderate, relapsed/refractory, metastatic, persistent, non-obstructive) are dropped correctly. Vaccine/prophylaxis strings map the infection (influenza x3, plague, shigellosis). Healthy-volunteers-with-disease maps the disease. Trial context disambiguates acronyms correctly (DM1 = myotonic dystrophy, TSC = TSC1/2 gene alterations -> null). Broader fallbacks check out against MONDO, which has no human term for status epilepticus, neurogenic bladder, peanut allergy or generic hernia ('Hernia' left null; MONDO has no human hernia/abdominal-wall-hernia container). Minor match-flag nits, not counted as errors: 'Hemiretinal Vein Occlusion' -> retinal vein occlusion and 'Lipoatrophy' -> lipodystrophy are flagged exact but are really parent terms (broader). 'SCD' -> sickle cell disease although one of its two trials uses SCD for spinocerebellar degeneration; the string is genuinely ambiguous. Only one systematic tendency: strings naming several diseases are sometimes collapsed to the first-named disease instead of a grouping (item 69 vs item 27).

notes: Sample: seeded (numpy default_rng(20261102)) 100 intervention strings in industry trials, drawn by python -m scripts.audit_samples. Each stored UNII was checked against preclin.unii_substance/unii_name; sponsor codes were checked against ClinicalTrials.gov v2 records and web sources. All 71 stored UNIIs are parent active moieties (no salt, hydrate or formulation records; canagliflozin anhydrous, desmopressin, tiotropium and glycopyrronium cations, purinostat parent). Placebo, vehicle and imaging strings carry no entity, and combination splitting and background roles are sound. Systematic patterns: (1) Sponsor codes are left unresolved when the INN is recent and GSRS does not list the code among the substance's names (DW4902 to merigolix, HS-10365 to resencatinib). The code-to-INN mapping depends on the LLM knowing it, and the UNII step only searches codes against registered names. (2) Korean bioequivalence reference-product codes (D745, D097, D337, CKD-828, CKD-348) are kept as opaque entities even when the trial title or summary names the drugs. (3) Descriptive biologic or allergen names miss their GSRS record because the candidate search needs an exact name match (phleum pratense pollen). (4) The entity name occasionally keeps a salt even when the UNII step picked the parent (purinostat mesylate), or takes the GSRS display form (iph-2101, 'pantoprazole, (s)-'). Comparator arms are labelled investigational or background inconsistently (topical testosterone and Uceris are investigational, naproxen is background), but the rubric's binary role does not cover comparators, so these were not counted as errors.

notes: Seeded (numpy default_rng(20261102)) sample of 100 drawn by python -m scripts.audit_samples. UNIIs checked against preclin.unii_substance/unii_name. Salt/counter-ion stripping, hydrate->parent (saxagliptin/docetaxel/cyclophosphamide/amoxicillin/cephradine anhydrous), prodrug esters with own INN (olmesartan medoxomil, tenofovir disoproxil, fosamprenavir), biosimilar->reference (Ontruzant->trastuzumab), quaternary cation (sofpironium), and combination splitting were all right. Systematic issue: IV fluids. Dextrose resolves to the 'unspecified form' grouping UNII in 4/5 dextrose products while plain DEXTROSE 10% got anhydrous dextrose, splitting one substance across two moieties. Sodium chloride is consistently named by the odd GSRS INN synonym 'compound solution of sodium chloride' (UNII correct, 5 items). Minor: non-therapeutic components listed as active (Fe placebo iron) get role principal because the role enum offers no 'non-therapeutic' option; ester handling is inconsistent (mometasone furoate kept, clindamycin phosphate stripped).

notes: Seeded (numpy default_rng(20261102)) sample of 20 drawn by python -m scripts.audit_samples. Every label PDF was fetched and its Highlights read (RMC + I&U). All 6 null outputs were right: Humira s215, Actemra s144 and Invokana s6 had W&P-only RMC, Duragesic s72 D&A-only, Victoza s1 and Empaveli s2 no RMC. Of the 14 positive extractions, 12 matched exactly the I&U RMC dated at the action month (Caldolor 3 mo pediatric, Sorilux/Taclonex 12+, Vimpat 4+, Jemperli all-comer EC, Symbyax/Zyprexa TRD and bipolar depression, Tecentriq cis-ineligible UC, Soliris aHUS, Xarelto CAD/PAD, Imbruvica pediatric cGVHD, Qulipta chronic migraine) and Exparel was right on the use but debatable on change_type. Failure mode: a label shared by several supplements approved weeks apart (Keytruda, Oct-Nov 2023) gives one undifferentiated 'I&U (1) 11/2023' RMC, and the model chose a recently added indication without checking which change belonged to this submission number. Supplements whose RMC lists only a section number need a diff against the previous supplement's label, or should be dropped as undetermined.
